lines.japanese: ……あら？
あ、どーもどーも、長い間お疲れさまでした～。大丈夫？　起きてる？　お尻痛くない？
lines.english: Ah, hello there. And congratulations—you made it all this way. You doing okay? Still awake? Sore from sitting so long?

lines.japanese: ハイ、というわけでね、これにておしまいというわけですよ、千歳鷲介の物語。
lines.english: Yes, and so there you have it. And that's that for the story of Shusuke Chitose.

lines.japanese: おしまいって、縁起でもないなオイィィ！
lines.english: The end? Don't make it sound like I died!

lines.japanese: なーんてね、今でもやってますよ楽しんでますよ毎日がんばってますよ？
lines.english: Kidding. I’m still here—still having fun, still working hard every day.

lines.japanese: 今日だってアゲアゲでね。これからみんなでカラオケですよ。も、がっつりアゲアゲでね。
lines.english: I'm riding high today, too. We're all off to karaoke in a minute—gonna get properly hyped.

lines.japanese: 仕事仲間や友達なんかと集まってね。歌って踊って大騒ぎってなもんですよ。
lines.english: Friends and the gang from work, all getting together to sing, dance, and make an almighty racket.

lines.japanese: どーすかあなたも？　たまには腹の底から歌ってみませんか？　ハイそれじゃあ、どーぞっ！
lines.english: How about you? When was the last time you sang your heart out? All right, then—take it away!

lines.japanese: しーん！
lines.english: Dead silence!

lines.japanese: はは、相変わらず無口っすねえ。たまにはハジけてみるのもいいもんっすよ？　一度きりの人生パーッとね！
lines.english: Ha ha. Quiet as ever. It feels good to cut loose once in a while, you know? You only live once, so live it up!

lines.japanese: なーんて、それも道を譲ってくれた兄弟がいたからなんですけどね。
lines.english: Though I can only say that because my brothers made way for me.

lines.japanese: まあこんなこと言ったら彼らは嫌がるかもしれませんけど、冗談抜きに感謝してるんです。
lines.english: They may not want to hear me say it, but jokes aside, I really am grateful to them.

lines.japanese: なんていうか足りなかったものが一つになる感覚？　隼人君の得たもの、鷹志君の得たもの、その他受けいれられる全てのもろもろ。
lines.english: How do I put it? It's like all the pieces we lacked have come together. What Hayato found, what Takashi found, and everything else I can bring myself to accept.

lines.japanese: そんなのがまとまって今の俺を形成してるわけですよ。はは、どーすかコレ、かっこいいでしょ？
lines.english: Those pieces together are who I am now. Ha ha. How's that? Pretty cool, right?

lines.japanese: ま、なーんて言っても、やってることは今までと変わらないんですけどね。ええ、ぬるぬるとひとの間をすり抜けながら、適当にやってますよ。
lines.english: Of course, after all that, I’m still doing exactly what I’ve always done: slithering between people and muddling through as I please.

lines.japanese: あなたもね、楽しんでおけるうちは楽しんでおかないとね。人生損しちゃいますよ。
lines.english: And you—you've got to enjoy life while you still can. Otherwise you're only shortchanging yourself.

lines.japanese: ――とと、そうでした、危うく言いわすれるところでしたけど、あなたにも感謝してますとも！　ええ！
lines.english: —Whoops, that's right. I nearly forgot: I owe you thanks too! Of course I do!

lines.japanese: や、ほら俺ってば寂しがり屋さんですからね？　ひとりじゃどうにもできないことだって、ひとに話すことで楽になって乗りきれた部分はあるんですよ。
lines.english: See, I'm a lonely sort of guy. There were things I could never have managed alone. Talking to somebody lightened the burden enough to get me through.

lines.japanese: や、や、いつかは死神だなんだって言っちゃってすいませんでした。ええ、反省してますよ。傷ついたでしょ？
lines.english: And, well, I’m sorry about calling you the Grim Reaper and all that once upon a time. I promise I’ve learned my lesson. Hurt your feelings, did I?

lines.japanese: ……しぃーん！
lines.english: ...Dead silence!

lines.japanese: はは、隙をついてなんか喋らせようと思ったんですが、ほーんと口が固いっすね。
lines.english: Ha ha. I thought I'd catch you off guard and get you to answer, but you really can keep your mouth shut.

lines.japanese: でもいつか機会があれば、夜を徹して話したいもんですね。語りあいたいもんですね。
lines.english: Still, if the opportunity ever comes, I'd like us to talk through the night. Really speak heart to heart.

lines.japanese: そのときは改めてお礼を……ま、なにもお出ししたりはできませんけどね！
lines.english: When that happens, I’ll thank you properly... Though I still won’t have anything to offer you!

lines.japanese: ありがとう。ここまで見守ってくれたキミに。そしてこれからもよろしく。
lines.english: Thank you—to you, who watched over me all this way. And I hope you'll stay with me from here on.

lines.japanese: いやあ、人生って本当にいいものですね。
lines.english: And there you have it: life really is a wonderful thing.
